hero.title: About RabbitQA
hero.subtitle: RabbitQA is the multi-agentic AI platform for digital product quality. We help banks, insurers, airlines, retailers, fintechs and ecommerce leaders predict risk, prevent failure and protect revenue across the full product development lifecycle.

vision.title: Our Vision
paragraphs: Quality stopped being a phase a long time ago. It has not yet become a system. We think the next decade of software will be judged less on how fast teams ship and more on whether they can prove what they shipped was right. Requirements will be governed like code. Evidence will be produced as work happens rather than assembled before a review. And AI will do the preparation while people keep the decisions.
That is the platform we are building.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Quality should never be the bottleneck. It should be the reason you can commit to a date and keep it.
paragraphs: For over a decade our engineers ran quality programmes for banks, insurers, airlines and retailers. Thousands of releases. Hundreds of audits. More production incidents than we would like to count.

We learned the same lesson every time. The defect that costs the most is never the one testing catches. It is the requirement that was wrong before anyone wrote a line of code, and by the time a test fails, the money is already spent.

RabbitQA is that lesson, built as a platform. Launched in 2024, it takes the governance model our teams applied by hand and gives it to AI agents that can apply it at the speed modern delivery demands.

howWeBuild.title: We kept people in the decisions.
paragraphs: Autonomy is the wrong goal for quality. Our customers answer to auditors, and a decision nobody can attribute is a decision nobody can defend. So approval is built in rather than offered as a setting, and the model stays under your contract, on your infrastructure if that is what your regulator expects.
Responsible AI is not a policy page for us. It is a constraint we accepted at the architecture stage.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do

items.title: Prevention over reaction.
items.text: We measure ourselves by the failures that never reached production, not the bugs we logged after the fact.

items.title: Outcomes over output.
items.text: Test counts are vanity. Risk reduced, releases shipped and revenue protected are the numbers that matter.

items.title: Governed, not gated.
items.text: Quality should accelerate teams, not block them. We govern the lifecycle so speed and compliance stop being a trade-off.

items.title: Evidence over claims.
items.text: Every metric we publish traces to a real engagement. We do not ship hollow superlatives.

items.title: Human judgement, always.
items.text: Agents do the work. People make the calls. We do not ship a mode that removes them, and we do not think we should.

hero.title: Security Built In. Standards Backed Up.
hero.intro: RabbitQA is a multi-agentic AI platform for digital product quality, helping enterprises predict risk, prevent failure, and protect revenue across the full software lifecycle. Protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of quality-critical processes is central to how we build and operate our platform.

certs.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certs.body: RabbitQA's Information Security Management System (ISMS) is certified to the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard. This certification covers the establishment, implementation, and continual improvement of information security controls across our platform. Your data is protected by a verified, audited system, not internal policy alone.

certs.name: ISO/IEC 42001
certs.body: RabbitQA holds ISO/IEC 42001 certification, the international standard for AI management systems, introduced in 2023. This covers responsible development, deployment, and oversight of AI within our platform, ensuring every AI agent operates within a governed, transparent framework. Every decision stays with your team.

certs.name: ISO 9001
certs.body: Our Quality Management System (QMS) is certified to ISO 9001. For a platform built to govern digital product quality, this runs deeper than compliance: it reflects the same systematic, auditable approach to quality that RabbitQA brings to your engineering lifecycle.

items.title: RabbitQA Wins Three Awards at The AI Awards 2026
items.excerpt: RabbitQA took home three separate awards at The AI Awards 2026, winning Best AI Product and two more categories for its work with Hopi and Quick Sigorta.

body.text: RabbitQA, the multi-agentic AI platform for digital product quality, has been recognised with three separate awards at The AI Awards 2026, one of the most prestigious global platforms for AI innovation.

Bringing together leading brands and their AI projects from across the world, The AI Awards 2026 saw RabbitQA claim three category wins, affirming its impact at a global scale. RabbitQA took the "Best AI Product" award, while the solution developed for Hopi earned recognition in "Best Use of AI in Retail" and the application built for Quick Sigorta was awarded "Best Ethical Risk Management in AI Outputs."
Barbaros: "We are expanding our global impact"

Özgür Arzu Barbaros, Co-founder and Co-CEO of RabbitQA, commented: "Winning three categories at The AI Awards 2026 demonstrates that RabbitQA is not only a world-class technology but a platform that is genuinely transforming business outcomes. The measurable impact we are creating across industries is the strongest validation of our growth strategy. We will continue building on this success as we expand our presence in international markets."
Emektar: "RabbitQA proves our technology strength"

Miraç Emektar, Co-founder and Co-CEO of RabbitQA, added: "These awards show how powerful RabbitQA is on a global scale and how it is driving transformation across different industries. We will continue deepening our expertise in end-to-end quality management through AI agents, and remain committed to creating lasting, high-impact outcomes in global markets."

items.title: Hopi and RabbitQA Win Best AI Usage in Retail at The AI Awards 2026
items.excerpt: The AI-driven retail experience model built on RabbitQA with Hopi won Best AI Usage in Retail at The AI Awards 2026, turning AI capability into measurable commercial value.

body.text: The AI-driven retail experience and revenue optimization model built on RabbitQA in collaboration with Hopi has won "Best AI Usage in Retail" at The AI Awards 2026.
The project demonstrates how AI can move beyond a technology layer and become a source of measurable business impact, delivering speed, quality, and tangible results at scale.

Hopi and Virgosol claimed first place in the "Best AI Usage in Retail" category at The AI Awards 2026, one of the world's leading technology award programs. The program brings together technology companies, startups, and innovative projects from across the globe and evaluates submissions on the criteria of business impact, innovation, and implementation success.

The award was presented at a ceremony held in London on 21 April 2026, recognising the "Approach to AI-Driven Retail Experience & Revenue Optimization" project for translating AI capability into measurable commercial value within the retail sector.
Quality as the foundation of AI-driven retail

As AI adoption accelerates across retail, ensuring that AI outputs are reliable, consistent, and aligned with business objectives becomes as critical as the AI capability itself. The solution built on RabbitQA enabled Hopi to govern quality across its AI-driven customer experience workflows end to end, from requirements through to production, ensuring that every AI output met reliability and performance standards before reaching the customer.

items.title: Quick Sigorta and RabbitQA Win Best Ethical Risk Management in AI Output
items.excerpt: Built on RabbitQA without any real customer data, the AI risk-management model for Quick Sigorta won Best Ethical Risk Management in AI Output at The AI Awards 2026.

body.text: The AI risk management model built on RabbitQA in collaboration with Quick Sigorta has won "Best Ethical Risk Management in AI Output" at The AI Awards 2026.
Developed without the use of real customer data, the system is being recognised as a new reference point for ethical and auditable AI practices in the insurance sector.

Quick Sigorta and Virgosol achieved international recognition with a model designed for the safe and auditable management of AI outputs. At The AI Awards 2026, one of the world's leading technology award programs, the two organisations took first place in the "Best Ethical Risk Management in AI Output" category.
Tested Without Real Customer Data

As AI adoption grows across the insurance sector, data security, regulatory compliance, and the auditability of AI outputs have become increasingly critical. The model built on RabbitQA and Loadmance offered a structural response to each of these challenges.

The system generated verifiable synthetic datasets for testing purposes, eliminating the need for real customer data throughout the process. An AI output control layer continuously monitored model results against reliability, bias, and compliance criteria.

Performance testing simulated real user behaviour without accessing any personal data, enabling measurement of system performance under load and stress conditions while targeting zero data leakage risk.
"We are turning AI into a manageable capability"

Quick Sigorta CEO Eyüp Özsoy noted that trust is the most important asset in the insurance sector and described transforming AI from a risk factor into an auditable enterprise capability as a strategic priority.
Özsoy added that the model moves ethical AI beyond a guiding principle, translating it into an operationally applicable standard.
"We brought ethical AI into operational reality"
Miraç Emektar, Co-founder and Co-CEO of RabbitQA, said the award demonstrates that work which moves ethical AI from rhetoric into practice is finding recognition at an international level.
Emektar noted that building a test ecosystem capable of operating without real customer data and in full regulatory compliance represents a significant engineering achievement for the industry.
